run_mock_server: run a mock GraySwan monitor server on a custom port with a configurable delay
run_slow_handler: run the SlowHandler to simulate a delayed POST response on the /cygnal/monitor endpoint
test_slow_handler: test the SlowHandler class by sending a POST request to /cygnal/monitor and verifying the delayed response
review_slow_handler: review the SlowHandler class and its do_POST method to understand the delay mechanism
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional CLI arguments for the mock server
